The renderer passes links through safeLinkUrl, but no svg case shows an unsafe href is dropped (folded into F1). planDelta: Planned 25 rows; 45 now, 1.8x (39 at cp4). The six added since cp4 are four splits of the SVG export core (M20.12 into M20.40, then M20.41-M20.43) and two Fixes-ci rows (M20.44, a theme-editor focus race on macOS; M20.45, a slow byte-wise deep equal and a noisy timing ratio). The SVG export carries nine ADR-0056 items, and a single row was never going to hold them. This milestone shows that an ADR with many numbered items should be planned as one row per item group, not split mid-row. The run since cp4 is healthy: eight commits, both cp4 reopens closed, two reds fixed in the next commit with Fixes-ci, and CI green at 412a69a with a 314 s cold setup. Lessons: a split row's commit must still name its cases in the gate leg (F1), and the cp1 lesson weakens with each split. Risks: (1) M20.13 (fonts and three-browser parity), M20.14 (Inkscape), M20.15 (studio and CLI) and the decompiler chain M20.16-M20.18 are all still ahead. (2) M20.19, M20.20 and M20.23 need nightly or CI-time evidence and have not started, flagged at every checkpoint since cp1; their wall-clock lead time now dominates the milestone's end. (3) M20.26 and M20.35 are still todo. (4) M20.25's one-run gate needs a three-engine host (F3).
